title: Era
description: Era is a real estate investment and brokerage corporation operating in New Cairo, built as a genuinely new brand entering the market, one meant to set a new standard rather than follow the existing ones.
direction: The identity is constructed, literally. The logo reads like a block of buildings: sharp, structural, load bearing. Every angle between the letterforms is deliberate, cut with the same precision you'd expect from architecture, not typography. That geometric confidence is the whole message, as if the logo, and the brand, are built on solid ground.

The color carries the same tone. Bold red against pitch black doesn't ask to be liked, it commands attention, the way a skyline does at night. Paired with the campaign line, "A Brand New Era," the identity positions itself exactly where the name says: not an evolution of something old, but a new standard altogether, fitting for a market like New Cairo that's still actively being built.
